### This creates pressure on scale-out architectures today, and how to design scale-up architectures moving forward

## Lumilens = the next-gen of photonic interconnects

We are rapidly changing how the world’s largest AI providers can use photonics to massively scale their AI infrastructure. Lumilens brings unique innovation and capabilities, including:

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a5e877034f32676fa783685_Section%20Container%20(1).png)

In-house developed silicon photonics & ICs

Unique silicon photonics, light sources, optical interposers, mixed-signal ICs – designed for superior yield and reliability.

Single platform & software architecture

The LumiCoreTM  Platform powers pluggables, NPO, and CPO – each feeding the data pipeline and feedback loop.

Ownership of manufacturing test, process and robotics

Lumilens owns its process recipes, automation, test equipment design, and MES — resulting in very high-volume manufacturing and quality.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6901033937f47012b6ca4f41_bg-new-approach.png)

## Why Lumilens is different

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a5758deb98ac9f70f08e725_lumicore_platform_icon%202.svg)

#### LumiCore™ platform

LumiCore is a fully integrated silicon platform -- photonics, mixed-signal ICs, electrical-optical interposers, and optical systems – that enables faster development, tighter integration for high-volume manufacturing, and better supply chain control

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a575902a882c8b9735d69f7_Faster%20Innovation.svg)

#### Tech that’s designed for HVM

Lumilens leverages unique silicon photonics, high power light sources, electrical-optical interposers – all designed for high-volume production, yield, reliability and superior margins. Multiple patents pending.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a575930712a5e21c44f2e6e_Systems%20Expertise.svg)

#### System-level knowledge

In addition to broad component-level expertise, Lumilens brings deep systems-level experience that provides strong value in developing customized scale-up architectures

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a575958ea587b459a63dfe8_GPU%20direct%20connect.svg)

#### Smooth transition from NPO to CPO

Lumilens provides hyperscalers with the ability to drive early adoption of scale-up using NPO and smoothly transition to full CPO over time, leveraging the common LumiCore silicon platform

## 100+ staff years  of developing silicon + device IP

### Pioneered

CPO/SiPh optimized for HVM

### 40+ years

in analog and mixed-signal ICs for high-speed comms

### 40+ years

in laser packaging and SiPh optical I/O

### Extensive

device library enabling Tb/mm², pJ/bit, $/Gb targets

## Scale-Up & Scale-Out

Two architectures…one supplier.

[Learn More](https://lumilens.com/photonic-interconnects)

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a575dad000fdb119247ecb9_Scale%20Up.png)

#### Scale-Up

Ultra high-performance, scalable to over 100x of current GPU direct connect limits with minimal latency

Built for high-volume manufacturing with tightly integrated optics

Highly customizable to meet hyperscaler customers’ specific needs and future roadmap requirements

#### Scale-Out

1000x better bit error rate reduces re-transmits and maximizes system throughput + reliability

High degree of robotic automation in production and test reduces costs and increases output

Multiple innovations in high-volume manufacturing test and calibration raise yields

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a575e19f6c63980f8f4846e_Scale%20Out.png)

## Next-gen photonics need next-gen manufacturing

Lumilens has developed next-generation manufacturing capabilities + facilities that employ end-to-end automation with robotics and AI-optimized processes.

[Learn More](https://lumilens.com/next-gen-manufacturing-robotics-ai)

Our customers benefit from:

### Faster pace

of innovation – initial products designed, qualified and shipped in < 2 years

### Higher production efficiency and yield

via significant investments in robotic automation of production and test calibration

### Supply chain continuity

via broad ecosystem and in-house design of silicon photonics and mixed-signal electrical ICs

### Ability to manufacture anywhere

using in-house automation systems for production and testing

### Experience working with hyperscalers

and full systems, ensuring faster design and deployment

## The leadership  to make it happen

Our founding and leadership team brings deep photonics and networking industry experience from Cisco, Juniper, Meta, Lumentum and Coherent.

Photonics are the answer for scaling AI infrastructure going forward.  While traditional scale out designs still have a lot of growth left, there is a massive opportunity to build native GPU-to-GPU scale up architectures.  Our goal at Lumilens is to be the leader in both.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6944103e1d86eb6f187a25c2_Frame%202117074137%20(1).png)

Ankur Singla

CEO & founder

AI and its required infrastructure continues to grow faster than the photonics industry can deliver solutions for it.  That’s why we founded Lumilens – to participate in that growth, while designing new ways to better connect and scale AI natively.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6924fc675f8bdc281235abd3_photo-3.png)

Samuel Liu

VP Products & founder

Since our founding days, Lumilens has approached innovation in photonics at a very global level.  Our India/APAC teams play a key role in delivering round-the-clock innovation and highly efficient manufacturing and operations.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6924fc680b62c4825f4f49eb_photo-2.png)

Ritesh Kapahi

VP/GM India & founder

You must approach innovation in photonics from a system-level perspective, not a component-level one.  That’s why we’ve built Lumilens with deeply experienced team members from across the board of leading networking and optical vendors.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6924fc6716c669b999736497_photo-4.png)

Dave Friedman

VP Operations & founder

The industry need is clear…how to scale AI infrastructure to meet the pace of this massive technology revolution.  And the answer is also clear…photonics to scale and reinvent ultra high-speed connectivity across GPUs.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6926faa6e877e2633bf4449c_Frame%202117074137.png)

Ted Schmidt

CTO & Founder

Photonics vendors have grown the market, but haven’t fully leveraged the actual AI that their connectivity enables.  Lumilens is designing its full-stack manufacturing from the ground up, using robotics and AI to the fullest extent.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6924fc68a8ec09fc8d5d2b30_photo-7.png)

Weich Fang

VP Manufacturing & Ops

Our in-house silicon innovation enables higher-density integration and more efficient fiber utilization, forming a unique foundation for both scale up and scale out architectures in modern AI data centers.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6924fc6870a331b82c471620_photo-5.png)

Harish Devanagondi

VP Engineering, Silicon

I’ve been at many innovative networking companies, from the early days of LANs, the Internet boom, and the start of cloud computing.  The role of photonics in scaling AI is as big, or bigger than, any of these.  And Lumilens will be at the heart of that.

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6924fc68559ea0d573bfbe31_photo-8.png)

Mark Weiner

CMO

![](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/68aa10a8e6f4d59001f9f05d/6a57627fa2a8d1950db7b6b0_Ellipse%2026206.png)
